_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'ashfall_hollow' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

ash_reader_kirra.name: Ash-reader Kirra
ash_reader_kirra.greeting: I read the ash the way you read a letter. This valley is one long, angry letter.

gakk_nuvaru.name: Gakk Nuvaru
gakk_nuvaru.greeting: I dig my front door out every morning. It builds character. And arms.

benno_lhessu.name: Benno Lhessu
benno_lhessu.greeting: Welcome to the inn. Mind the stairs, the inn is the cellar now. Was the roof, once.

angler_cinderholt.name: Gethu Rhovek
angler_cinderholt.greeting: The water's grey with ash. The fish are grey with ash. I am grey with ash. See the ripples, just east of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_cinderholt.name: Ilko Zhakku
carter_cinderholt.greeting: Walking is free. Riding is nearly free, and you arrive with your feet unboiled.

quests.name: Digging Out
quests.offer: I finally dug my cellar out. It was already occupied. Crawlers, all through the buried cellars, all very comfortable.

steps.text: Kill 8 scoria crawlers in the buried cellars

quests.done: My cellar! Full of ash, but mine. I am going to sit in it.

quests.name: What the Ash Recalls
quests.offer: Stiltreach sent you with that cake? Put it down, it is warm. The last time the Mother erupted, the Slagborn's grandmothers had been feeding her for a year. Cinderholt is what she gave back. Their firecallers are in our streets again, reading the old rite off our buried walls.

steps.text: Kill 6 Slagborn firecallers in the buried streets
Take 3 rubbings of the old rite from the firecallers
Bring the rubbings to Ash-reader Kirra in Cinderholt

quests.done: The rite does not end in a valley. It ends at the crater lake, at Rim Shrine. They mean to wake what sleeps in the water, and let it empty the island for them. Go up. The Rim-keepers will need every hand.

quests.name: The Ashen Reeve
quests.offer: Before the ash came, Cinderholt had a reeve who collected the rents. He still does. From the dead, and from me. The Ashen Reeve walks the old square at dusk with his book.

steps.text: Kill 3 obsidian wardens in the old square

quests.done: Rent paid in full, forever. I will burn the book. It is already mostly burned, but I will finish it.

quests.name: The Cellar Queen
quests.offer: Under the cellars there are more cellars, and the Cellar Queen holds court in the deepest one. Everyone who digs too far ends up at her table.

steps.where: the deepest cellars of Ashfall Hollow

quests.done: No more court. I can dig in peace. Slowly. With great care.

quests.name: Under Cinderholt
quests.offer: Most of the old town is still down there under the ash: streets, houses, a hall, all of it. Something keeps the lamps lit. Take a party and find out who pays for the oil.

steps.text: Go down into the buried town Under Cinderholt
steps.where: Under Cinderholt, the dungeon door in Ashfall Hollow

steps.text: Defeat what keeps the old town lit

quests.done: Dark, at last, and the dead can rest in it. The crater lake shore is where you go when you want harder work.

quests.name: The Buried Mayor
quests.offer: Every so often the ash in the square heaves and the old mayor climbs out to give a speech. Nobody wants the speech. When the bell starts, come and help us cut it short.

steps.where: the old square of Cinderholt, when the bell rings (zone event)
steps.text: Defeat the Buried Mayor when he rises

quests.done: Shortest speech he ever gave. The kiln folk on the ridge to the west pay well, if your arms still work.
